question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**and**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The items in the list are related and happen together in the process of managing the outbreak, so the appropriate connector is "**and**".
 
• "and" is the correct choice because it is used to connect related actions in a list.
 
• All of these actions (like procuring protective gear and vaccines) are part of the same effort to control the outbreak, so "and" is the most logical conjunction to link them.
 
• Other options ("**or**", "**yet**", "**but**") do not fit the context of contrasting the regular occurrence of burning.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Or: "Or" is used to link alternatives.
 
• **yet : **"Yet" would suggest a change in direction, which doesn't apply in this case.
 
• **But:** "But" is used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned.
